title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.30132v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is an effective way to strengthen the long-context reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but it needs training data that are long, diverse, challenging, and verifiable. Human annotation of such data is expensive, naturally occurring data are too scarce to sustain RL, and existing synthesis methods depend on external corpora or stronger teacher models, which become harder to obtain as the trained models get stronger. Recently, RL from zero data, in which a model learns from tasks it proposes itself, has achieved excellent performance, but existing methods target short-context tasks. Therefore, we propose $\textbf{LongZero}$, a method that lets an LLM improve its own long-context reasoning without any external data. translated_title: LongZero：从零数据出发增强大语言模型的长上下文推理能力
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）是提升大语言模型（LLM）长上下文推理能力的有效途径，但它需要长篇、多样、具有挑战性且可验证的训练数据。人工标注此类数据成本高昂，自然存在的数据又过于稀缺而无法支撑强化学习，而现有的数据合成方法依赖外部语料库或更强的教师模型，随着被训练模型能力的提升，这些依赖越来越难以获得。最近，从零数据出发的强化学习——即模型从自身提出的任务中学习——取得了出色的效果，但现有方法仅针对短上下文任务。因此，我们提出了LongZero，一种让LLM在无需任何外部数据的情况下提升自身长上下文推理能力的方法。LongZero不是在现有文档上编写问题和答案，而是首先让模型以紧凑的结构化形式合成问题、答案及其支持证据，并……
tldr: LongZero提出了一种无需任何外部数据的自举式强化学习方法，让大语言模型通过自行合成结构化的问题-答案-证据任务来生成训练数据，从而有效提升自身的长上下文推理能力。
en_tdlr: LongZero enables LLMs to improve their own long-context reasoning through reinforcement learning without any external data, by having the model self-synthesize structured question-answer-evidence tasks from zero data.
